items.label: ISC Tenant URL
items.helpText: Your ISC tenant API base URL, e.g. https://tenant.api.identitynow.com

items.label: Client ID
items.helpText: OAuth client ID for connector authentication

items.label: Client Secret
items.helpText: OAuth client secret for connector authentication

items.label: Enable Stateful (Delta) Aggregation
items.helpText: Enable delta (stateful) aggregation for std:account:list. When enabled, the connector should call res.saveState() to persist state between runs.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: OAuth client ID (unique anchor)

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: OAuth client display name

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: OAuth client description

attributes.name: enabled
attributes.description: Whether the OAuth client is enabled

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: OAuth client type, such as CONFIDENTIAL or PUBLIC

attributes.name: grantTypes
attributes.description: OAuth 2.0 grant types (e.g. CLIENT_CREDENTIALS, AUTHORIZATION_CODE)

attributes.name: scopes
attributes.description: Granted ISC API scopes (the governance unit for certification)

attributes.name: accessType
attributes.description: Access type assigned to the OAuth client

attributes.name: created
attributes.description: When the OAuth client was created

attributes.name: modified
attributes.description: When the OAuth client was last modified

attributes.name: lastUsed
attributes.description: When the OAuth client was last used

attributes.name: consentRequired
attributes.description: Whether user consent is required for the OAuth client

attributes.name: claimsSupported
attributes.description: Whether claims are supported by the OAuth client

attributes.name: strongAuthSupported
attributes.description: Whether strong authentication is supported

attributes.name: accessTokenValiditySeconds
attributes.description: Access token lifetime in seconds

attributes.name: refreshTokenValiditySeconds
attributes.description: Refresh token lifetime in seconds

attributes.name: internal
attributes.description: Whether the OAuth client is marked as internal

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Serialized metadata for the OAuth client

attributes.name: integrationId
attributes.description: Integration identifier associated with the OAuth client

attributes.name: businessName
attributes.description: Business owner or business-facing name for the OAuth client

attributes.name: homepageUrl
attributes.description: Homepage URL registered for the OAuth client

attributes.name: redirectUris
attributes.description: Redirect URIs registered for the OAuth client

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Scope identifier string (e.g. sp:scopes:all, idn:access-request:read)

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Scope display name (same as id — no enrichment catalog available)
